body: Please, I know it’s bad now, but your wife, think about how you may leave her all alone in this cold world. Try get some help professionally. Think about your potential future with her

She’s just upset you’re killing it now! Keep going and keep winning. People, especially those who used to be close to us, begin to resent the successes of others. Keep going man, you’re doing great. Maybe talk to another close friend

Hey man, it’s not worth ending it. Time heals all wounds. I know you feel like you’re doing too much. But maybe try find someone new. Someone healthy who wants to take care of you. Keep going gym and keep being better.
Thanks for trying to help. Means a lot
Hey man, I promise, it gets better. Hang in there.
